disambiguation: Anime Card Clash is a rolling and deck building game. It is not Anime Card Battlegrounds or Anime Cards Simulator, and codes do not carry across.
redeem_path: Launch Anime Card Clash, click the Codes button on the in game navigation on the left of the screen, type the code into the Enter code here box, then press Redeem.
redeem_requirements: none for most codes, but some COMMUNITY tier codes have carried a rerolls threshold, reported at around 500,000 lifetime rerolls.

The whole CHAINSAW family shipped with the 7 August update and died within days. Expiry date is approximate, taken from a report that they lasted just a few days.

next_drop.pattern: Codes arrive in numbered families named after the licensed anime crossover in each update, for example the CHAINSAW set on 7 August and the DRAGONBALL set on 22 August. They die within roughly five days. The developer also issues codes as compensation after maintenance and at player milestones.
